items.title: Cassius Wilson Interview, 1962-04-05
items.q: Well we have two big fellas for the parades of marshal, Willie Hicks and his fella named Cass, they call him.

ctx.x: All of them is different. Different designs, different colors. Just like their baskets. The baskets are decorated, different they have a basket. Oh I guess it sets about that high. About three feet almost. Oh yes, some of them are so tall that guy, when he's walking he's got to hold this away. He can't hold it down. He's got to hold it up. Now mostly your marshal pretty much has the extra large basket. Your marshal of the day, I think he's the first man, that's the grand marshal. He's leading the whole…
He looks good out there. Oh he looks better good.
